rationale: The bid-ask spread of 243 bps creates an immediate structural disadvantage that makes any intraday trade extremely difficult to profit from, as the cost to enter and exit alone consumes a significant portion of any realistic move. The stock has gapped down 15% on mixed earnings (revenue miss despite EPS beat) and is currently printing at the absolute low of today's range with only two 1-minute candles of data, making directional conviction near-impossible — the price could be in freefall or finding a bottom. The ATR of $0.46 on 5-minute bars is far too small relative to the spread and the volatility of the gap, making reliable stop placement and risk/reward calculation unreliable.
